makaleler.baslik: Cost-effectiveness analysis of FundoRing versus standard one-anastomosis gastric bypass: up to 3-year results of a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: FundoRing ve Standart OAGB Maliyet Etkinlik Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1000 hastalıklı RCT'de, FundoRing grubu standart OAGB'ye kıyasla daha yüksek etkinlik (%94,2'ye karşı %86,7; P=0,002) ve daha düşük toplam maliyet (-829,90 USD) gösterdi. FundoRing, geç komplikasyonların azalmasıyla dominant strateji olarak belirlendi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The FundoRing modification of one-anastomosis gastric bypass (OAGB) has demonstrated superior clinical outcomes compared with standard OAGB in patients with metabolic syndrome. However, the cost-effectiveness of this innovative technique remains unclear. This study aimed to perform a cost-effectiveness analysis of FundoRing versus standard OAGB using the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) and the cost-effectiveness plane.
METHODS: A cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted alongside a randomized controlled trial including 1000 patients (n = 500 FundoRing, n = 500 standard OAGB) with metabolic syndrome and up to 3 years of follow-up (median: 28 months, IQR: 22-34 months). Effectiveness was measured as the proportion of patients who achieved a target BMI of <30 kg/m2 at their last follow-up visit. Direct medical costs, including surgical intervention, hospitalization, postoperative follow-up, and management of late complications, were calculated from the healthcare-system perspective. Costs were converted from the Kazakhstani tenge (KZT) to US dollars (USD) using the 2025 exchange rate (521.59 KZT/USD). The willingness-to-pay (WTP) threshold was used as a contextual benchmark, with the understanding that the primary conclusion on cost-effectiveness relies on the dominance finding. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was calculated as the difference in costs divided by the difference in effectiveness. A probabilistic sensitivity analysis with 5000 bootstrap iterations was performed to construct the cost-effectiveness plane.
RESULTS: At the last follow-up (median 28 months), the FundoRing group demonstrated significantly higher effectiveness (94.2% vs. 86.7% achieving BMI <30 kg/m2; P = 0.002) and significantly lower total costs per patient (5928.10 USD vs. 6758.00 USD, difference -829.90 USD, 95% CI: -1184.2 to -475.6). The cost savings in the FundoRing group were primarily driven by a reduced incidence of late complications such as dumping syndrome (13.7% vs. 36.5%; P < 0.001), marginal ulcers (0.2% vs. 2.9%; P < 0.001), and bile reflux esophagitis (0.2% vs. 8.1%; P < 0.001). The ICER was -11 065 USD per patient achieving the target BMI. On the cost-effectiveness plane, 100% of the bootstrap iterations fell in the southeast quadrant, indicating that FundoRing is a dominant strategy (lower costs and higher effectiveness).
CONCLUSION: FundoRing modification of OAGB is a more cost-effective strategy than standard OAGB within the studied population and single-center setting. The reduction in late postoperative complications generates substantial healthcare savings while achieving superior clinical outcomes. These findings provide economic evidence to support the use of the FundoRing technique in bariatric surgery. Multi-center studies are needed to confirm generalizability.

makaleler.baslik: Dual benefit of esketamine-based opioid-free anesthesia on postoperative pain and mental health outcomes in patients undergoing bariatric surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahide Esketamin Bazlı Opioid İçermeyen Anestezi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 84 hastalıklı RCT'de, laparoskopik sleeve gastrektomi sırasında esketamin bazlı opioid içermeyen anestezi, ilk 24 saatte daha düşük postoperatif ağrı ve 3 ayda daha iyi ruh sağlığı sonuçları sağladı.
makaleler.ozet: Patients with morbid obesity are at a high risk of comorbid depressive and anxiety symptoms. While bariatric surgery is an effective treatment, conventional opioid-based anesthesia carries significant perioperative risks. Opioid-free anesthesia (OFA) presents a safer alternative. Esketamine, known for its dual analgesic and rapid antidepressant effects, is a promising component of OFA. However, clinical evidence supporting its simultaneous benefits for both physical and psychological recovery in bariatric patients remains limited. In this double-blind, randomized clinical trial, patients scheduled for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either esketamine-based anaesthesia or opioid-based anaesthesia with remifentanil during surgery. The co-primary outcomes were postoperative pain intensity within the first 24 h and mental health status at three months after surgery. Secondary outcomes included pharmacokinetics of esketamine and adverse events. A total of 84 patients were randomized, with 42 allocated to each group. Seventy-four participants (88.1%) completed the 3-month follow-up. Patients in the esketamine group experienced significantly lower postoperative pain intensity (P < 0.01) and a reduced incidence of moderate-to-severe pain (P < 0.05) within 24 h after surgery. Mental health outcomes at 3 months were also significantly better in the esketamine group, and adverse events rate did not differ significantly. Pharmacokinetic analysis showed that plasma esketamine concentrations increased rapidly during infusion, with early formation of the active metabolite (S)-norketamine. Compared to opioid-based anaesthesia, esketamine-based opioid-free anaesthesia was associated with improved postoperative analgesia and better mental health outcomes in morbidly obese patients undergoing bariatric surgery, without increasing adverse events.

makaleler.baslik: Nutritional Independence After Bariatric Surgery: Recovery, Reintervention, and Long-Term Survival.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Nütrisyonel Bağımsızlık
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Tek merkezli retrospektif çalışmada, bariatrik cerrahi sonrası enteral veya parenteral desteğe ihtiyaç duyan 168 hastanın %88,1'i nütrisyonel bağımsızlığa ulaştı. Bağımsızlığa ulaşanların %85,1'i endoskopik veya cerrahi müdahale gerektirdi ve gecikmiş bağımsızlıkta mortalite oranı %20,4 idi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Nutritional failure requiring enteral or parenteral support is a serious complication of bariatric surgery, but its long-term course, likelihood of recovery, and relationship with survival are poorly characterized.
STUDY DESIGN: We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study of adults requiring enteral or parenteral nutrition after bariatric surgery from 2004-2023. Nutritional independence was defined as discontinuation of all supplemental nutrition for ≥3 months. Kaplan-Meier and Cox proportional hazards analyses evaluated survival; a 12-month landmark analysis addressed immortal time bias.
RESULTS: Among 168 patients (85.1% female; median age 41.2 years; median BMI 47.3 kg/m²), 148 (88.1%) achieved nutritional independence during a median 11.6-year follow-up. Of these, 126 (85.1%) required endoscopic or surgical intervention, most commonly addressing gastrojejunal complications. Median time from nutritional support initiation to independence was 12.1 months. Among 165 patients alive and in follow-up at 12 months, mortality was 20.4% in 93 patients not yet independent versus 6.9% in 72 independent patients (HR 2.56, 95% CI 0.95 to 6.90, p=0.064). Of those not independent at 12 months, 74/93 (79.6%) subsequently achieved independence.
CONCLUSIONS: Nutritional dependence after bariatric surgery was usually reversible, predominantly through endoscopic or surgical correction rather than nutritional support alone. Delayed nutritional independence was associated with numerically higher mortality, although this did not reach statistical significance. Timely, anatomy-specific intervention should therefore be prioritized to restore nutritional autonomy.

tez.baslik: Morbid obezite nedeniyle sleeve gastrektomi yapılan hastalarda adiponektin-leptin oranının kilo vermede etkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Sleeve Gastrektomi Yapılan Hastalarda Adiponektin-Leptin Oranının Kilo Vermeye Etkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: 78 obez hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, postoperatif 1. yılda VKİ 44 ± 7 kg/m²'den 29.0 ± 4.0 kg/m²'ye gerilemiştir (p<0.001). Preoperatif adiponektin/leptin oranı ile %FKK arasında orta düzeyde anlamlı pozitif korelasyon (r=0.39, p<0.001) saptanırken, %TKK ile ilişki gözlenmemiştir (p=0.868).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, morbid obezite tanısıyla laparoskopik sleeve gastrektomi (LSG) uygulanan hastalarda, ameliyat öncesi serum adiponektin/leptin (A/L) oranının postoperatif 1. yıldaki kilo kaybı başarısı üzerindeki prediktif değerini incelemektir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Kasım 2024 ile Mart 2026 tarihleri arasında LSG operasyonu geçiren ve 12 aylık takibi tamamlanan 78 obez hasta çalışmaya dâhil edildi. Hastaların preoperatif serum adiponektin ve leptin düzeyleri ölçüldü. Postoperatif 12. ayda fazla kilo kaybı yüzdesi (%FKK) ve toplam kilo kaybı yüzdesi (%TKK) hesaplandı. Verilerin analizinde Spearman korelasyon testi ve Sağlam Doğrusal Regresyon (RLM) yöntemleri kullanıldı. Bulgular: Katılımcıların %81'i kadın olup yaş ortalaması 37 ± 11 yıl olarak saptandı. Preoperatif ortalama Vücut Kitle İndeksi (VKİ) 44 ± 7 kg/m² iken, postoperatif 1. yılda 29.0 ± 4.0 kg/m²'ye anlamlı oranda geriledi (p<0.001). Ortalama %FKK %82 ± 16, %TKK ise %34 ± 6 olarak hesaplandı. Ameliyat öncesi ortalama adiponektin/leptin oranı 0.52 ± 0.32 olarak bulundu. İstatistiksel analiz sonucunda, preoperatif A/L oranı ile %FKK arasında orta derecede anlamlı pozitif bir korelasyon (r=0.39, p<0.001) saptanırken, %TKK ile anlamlı bir ilişki gözlenmedi (p=0.868). Çok değişkenli regresyon analizinde ise %FKK başarısını bağımsız olarak öngören faktörlerin bazal VKİ, HbA1c ve HDL düzeyleri olduğu saptandı. Sonuç: Ameliyat öncesi yüksek adiponektin/leptin oranı, LSG sonrası 1. yıldaki hedeflenen ideal kiloya ulaşma başarısı (%EWL) ile doğrudan ilişkilidir. Bu oran, hastanın cerrahiye vereceği ağırlık kaybı yanıtını öngörmede tek değişkenli analizlerde güçlü bir biyobelirteçtir. Ancak, cerrahi başarının uzun dönemli yönetiminde hastanın bazal metabolik profili ve başlangıç VKİ değerlerinin çok değişkenli modellerde daha belirleyici olduğu görülmektedir.

makaleler.baslik: Randomized Trial of Hypofractionated Postmastectomy Radiation Therapy in Women With Breast Reconstruction (RT CHARM, Alliance A221505).
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Rekonstrüksiyonu Sonrası Hipofraksiyone PMRT: Randomize Çalışma
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Meme rekonstrüksiyonu yapılan 898 hastayı içeren RCT'de, 3,9 yıllık medyan takip sonucunda 24 aylık rekonstrüksiyon komplikasyon oranları hipofraksiyone PMRT kolunda %12,3, konvansiyonel PMRT kolunda %10,2 bulundu (tahmini fark -%2,1; %95 CI, -6,5 ila 2,2). 36 aylık lokorejyonel nüks oranlarında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark saptanmadı (%1,5'e karşı %2,2). Hipofraksiyone PMRT, rekonstrüksiyon uygulanan kadınlarda güvenli ve noninferior bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Patients with breast cancer requiring postmastectomy radiation therapy (PMRT) often desire breast reconstruction. Reconstructions can be adversely affected by PMRT, and fear of reconstruction complications has discouraged adoption of short-course radiation therapy used after lumpectomy. To fill the evidence gap, we conducted a noninferiority trial of hypofractionated versus conventional PMRT in patients undergoing breast reconstruction. The primary outcome was reconstruction complication rate, a composite of wound healing, readmission, capsular contracture, unplanned reoperation, and reconstruction failure.
METHODS: Women with unilateral invasive breast cancer with planned immediate or delayed reconstruction and PMRT were randomly assigned (1:1) to 50 Gy (25 fractions/5 weeks) or 42.56 Gy (16 fractions/3 weeks). This study was designed with a noninferiority margin of 10%, assuming a 2-year reconstruction complication rate of 25% with conventional PMRT. Randomization was stratified by immediate versus delayed and autologous versus implant-only reconstruction.
RESULTS: Between 2018 and 2021, 898 patients enrolled with a median follow-up of 3.9 years; 825 patients were evaluable for the primary end point. The 24-month reconstruction complication rates were 12.3% (52/422) with hypofractionated PMRT and 10.2% (41/403) with conventional PMRT, corresponding to an estimated difference of -2.1% (95% CI, -6.5 to 2.2). The complication rate was higher (regardless of arm) with implant-only versus autologous reconstruction (odds ratio = 1.65). There was no statistically significant difference in 36-month locoregional recurrence rates: 1.5% (95% CI, 0.7 to 3.2) with hypofractionated and 2.2% (95% CI, 1.1 to 4.3) with conventional PMRT. Acute and late toxicity rates were not statistically different.
CONCLUSION: A 16-fraction course of hypofractionated PMRT is safe and noninferior to conventional PMRT in women undergoing breast reconstruction after mastectomy.

makaleler.baslik: 8th International consensus guidelines for the management of advanced breast cancer (ABC8 guidelines).
makaleler.baslik_tr: İleri Evre Meme Kanseri Yönetimi İçin ABC8 Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Geniş bir küresel konsensus paneli tarafından hazırlanan ABC8 kılavuzları, inoperabl lokal ileri veya metastatik meme kanseri hastalarının yönetiminde en güncel kanıtları ve uzman görüşlerini sunmaktadır. Kılavuz, tanı ve tedavi algoritmalarının yanı sıra kaynak kısıtlı ortamlarda erişimin önceliklendirilmesine yardımcı olmak amacıyla kanıt düzeylerini içermektedir.
makaleler.ozet: The Advanced Breast Cancer (ABC) 8th international consensus conference took place on 6-8 November 2025, in Lisbon, and updated the previous ABC international consensus guidelines that are described in this manuscript. These guidelines reflect the work of a large and global consensus panel, comprising healthcare professionals and patients, and provide recommendations on how to best manage patients with advanced breast cancer (inoperable locally advanced or metastatic), of all breast cancer subtypes. The guidelines are based on the best available evidence or on expert opinion when a higher level of evidence is lacking and aim to cover the needs of the person living with ABC, including but also beyond the main therapeutic recommendations. Each guideline is accompanied by the level of evidence (LoE), the grade of recommendation (GoR), and the percentage of consensus reached at the consensus session. Updated diagnostic and treatment algorithms are also provided. These guidelines are endorsed by several international oncology organizations (AGO, AORTIC, ECO, EONS, ESO, ESTRO, EUSOMA, GECO Perú, SUMA, MASCC, French Breast Cancer Guidelines and AMAAC) and have official representation from ASCO, NCCN and ABC-NZ. Inequalities in access to high-quality care have increased in the last decade, both between and within countries, and are a major concern. The ABC guidelines provide guidance on the best available management options for patients living with ABC globally, assuming availability of the recommended therapies. Their adaptation is often needed in resource-constrained settings, and the grading of each recommendation may help in prioritizing access to available options.

makaleler.baslik: Ketamine Versus Magnesium Sulphate as Adjuvants to Bupivacaine in Pectoral Nerve Blocks for Mastectomy: A Randomized, Double-Blind Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mastektomi Sonrası Pektoral Sinir Bloklarında Ketamin ve Magnezyum Sülfat Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Modifiye radikal mastektomi yapılacak 72 hastada yapılan çift kör RCT'de, bupivakaine eklenen ketamin ve magnezyum sülfat adjuvanları postoperatif analjeziyi iyileştirmiş ve opioid tüketimini azaltmıştır. Ketamin, ilk kurtarıcı analjezi süresini uzatma (10 saate karşı 8 saat; p=0,023) ve pethidin tüketimini düşürme (75 mg'a karşı 100 mg; p=0,018) açısından magnezyum sülfattan üstün bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pectoral nerve blocks (PECS) provide effective regional analgesia after mastectomy, but the optimal adjuvant remains unclear. This study compared ketamine and magnesium sulphate as adjuvants to bupivacaine in PECS blocks.
METHODS: In this randomized, double-blind trial, 72 patients scheduled for modified radical mastectomy were randomized into 3 equal groups (n = 24). Group A received 0.25% bupivacaine with saline (control); Groups B and C received bupivacaine with ketamine or magnesium sulphate, respectively. The primary outcome was time to first rescue analgesia; secondary outcomes included 24-hour pethidine consumption, postoperative pain (Visual Analog Scale, VAS), and hemodynamic parameters.
RESULTS: Baseline and intraoperative parameters were comparable among groups. Postoperatively, the control group had significantly higher heart rate, mean arterial pressure, and respiratory rate than both adjuvant groups during the first 12 hours. VAS scores were lower in both adjuvant groups than in the control group, and lower with ketamine than with magnesium sulphate from 1 to 8 hours. Both adjuvants significantly prolonged time to first rescue analgesia and reduced 24-hour pethidine consumption compared with control. Ketamine achieved a longer median time to first rescue analgesia (10 [IQR 8-12] vs. 8 [IQR 4-8] hours; P = .023) and lower median pethidine consumption (75 [IQR 50-100] vs. 100 [IQR 100-112.5] mg; P = .018) than magnesium sulphate.
CONCLUSION: Ketamine and magnesium sulphate both improve postoperative analgesia and reduce opioid consumption after mastectomy. Ketamine was superior to magnesium sulphate and may be the preferred adjuvant, though larger trials are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Integrating ctDNA-Based ESR1m Monitoring Into First-Line Care for ER+, HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer: A Consensus Workflow.
makaleler.baslik_tr: ER+, HER2- İleri Meme Kanserinde ctDNA Bazlı ESR1m İzleme Konsensusu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: PADA-1 ve SERENA-6 klinik çalışmalarına dayanarak geliştirilen bu uzlaşı modeli, östrojen reseptör pozitif, HER2 negatif ileri meme kanserinde birinci basamak endokrin tedavi sırasında ortaya çıkan ESR1 mutasyonlarının (ESR1m) ctDNA ile izlenmesi için pratik bir iş akışı sunmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet: Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) is an emerging tool in precision oncology that enables noninvasive tumor profiling, detection of minimal residual disease, and treatment monitoring. Furthermore, routine ctDNA analyses offer the potential to support more personalized and dynamic cancer care. In advanced breast cancer (aBC), ctDNA-based monitoring has been investigated across multiple studies as a tool for detecting emerging resistance mechanisms, predicting treatment responses and informing biomarker-guided treatment decisions. One example, investigated in the phase III PADA-1 and SERENA-6 trials, is monitoring for emergent estrogen receptor alpha mutations (ESR1m) during first-line endocrine therapy in estrogen-receptor positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (ER+, HER2-) aBC. While not yet widely adopted in clinical practice, broader implementation of routine ctDNA-based monitoring for ESR1m is anticipated and will require standardized diagnostic workflows, encompassing both institutional operational processes and patient-centered scheduling pathways. Insights and recommendations were gathered from multidisciplinary experts across academic and community practices in the US regarding the feasibility, barriers, and operational requirements for implementing ESR1m monitoring during first-line treatment of aBC. Here, we present practical, experience-informed considerations, supplemented by an opinion-based consensus workflow model designed to provide clinicians with a flexible framework for implementing ctDNA-based ESR1m monitoring during first-line care for ER+, HER2- aBC.

makaleler.baslik: Indocyanine Green Angiography Reduces Ischemic Complications in Immediate Implant-Based Breast Reconstruction: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: IMB Rekonstrüksiyonda ICGA'nın İskemik Komplikasyonlara Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1356 rekonstrükte memeyi içeren 9 çalışmanın yer aldığı meta-analizde, intraoperatif ICGA kullanımı genel MSFN riskini %43 ve şiddetli MSFN riskini %65 oranında azaltmıştır. Ayrıca yeniden operasyon ihtiyacını ve flap kurtarma prosedürlerini anlamlı düzeyde düşürmüştür.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Skin- and nipple-sparing mastectomy followed by immediate implant-based breast reconstruction (IBBR) has grown substantially in clinical practice, yet mastectomy skin flap necrosis (MSFN) persists as a clinically significant source of morbidity. Intraoperative indocyanine green angiography (ICGA) enables real-time, objective quantification of skin flap perfusion, but its specific effect on IBBR outcomes has yet to be established through dedicated meta-analytic synthesis. This study aimed to evaluate whether intraoperative ICGA-guided decision-making lowers the incidence of MSFN and related surgical complications relative to conventional clinical appraisal in immediate IBBR.
METHODS: Four databases-PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library-were searched through March 2026 for comparative studies of immediate IBBR. Pooled risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using the Mantel-Haenszel method.
RESULTS: Nine studies comprising 1,356 reconstructed breasts (655 ICGA; 701 clinical assessment) met inclusion criteria. ICGA was associated with significantly lower risks of overall MSFN (RR 0.57, 95% CI 0.44-0.73) and severe MSFN (RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.22-0.55), as well as reduced return to the operating room, surgical-site infection, and flap salvage procedures. Overall complication rates, hematoma/seroma, and implant loss were not significantly different between groups.
CONCLUSIONS: Intraoperative ICGA significantly reduced the risk of overall MSFN by approximately 43% and severe MSFN by approximately 65%, with fewer unplanned reoperations and flap salvage procedures, without affecting non-ischemic outcomes. The evidence supports selective incorporation of ICGA into IBBR surgical protocols, with particular emphasis on patients carrying elevated perfusion-related risk.
LEVEL OF EVIDENCE III: This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine Ratings, please refer to Table of Contents or online Instructions to Authors www.springer.com/00266 .

tez.baslik: Erken evre meme kanserinde preoperatif aksillanın ultrasonografi ile değerlendirmesinin sentinel lenf nodu yönetiminde değerliliği
tez.baslik_tr: Erken Evre Meme Kanserinde USG ile Aksilla Evrelemesi
tez.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan tedavi almayan 338 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, USG'nin sentinel lenf nodu metastazını saptamada %33 duyarlılığa ve %92 özgüllüğe sahip olduğu görülmüştür. USG negatifliği T1 ve LVI negatif hastalarda doğruluk oranını artırmıştır.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Meme kanserinde aksilla cerrahisi; potansiyel morbiditesi nedeniyle daha az invaziv tekniklere doğru evrilmiştir. Kemoterapi ve radyoterapi tedavilerinin gelişmesi ile aksiller lenf nodu diseksiyonu (ALND) yapılan hastalar azalmıştır. Günümüzde kılavuzlar, uygun hastalarda sentinel lenf nodu örneklemesi (SLNÖ) sonucunda sınırlı pozitif lenf nodu olduğunda ALND'nin yapılmayabileceğini önermektedir. Aksillanın preoperatif radyolojik görüntülemeler ile evrelemesi önem kazanmaktadır. Ultrasonografi (USG) bu amaçla sık kullanılan ve klinik karar aşamasında rolü olan bir tetkiktir. Çalışmamızda preoperatif USG verileri ile SLNÖ verilerinin uyumluluğu değerlendirilerek aksilla evrelemesinde ultrasonun değerliliğinin ve SLNÖ'nin atlanabileceği uygun hasta profilinin ortaya koyulması amaçlanmıştır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Eylül 2022- Şubat 2025 tarihleri arasında Etlik Şehir Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniğinde meme kanseri nedeniyle ameliyat edilen kadın olguların verileri retrospektif olarak incelendi. Neoadjuvan tedavi gören hastalar dahil edilmedi. Dahil edilen 338 olgunun yaşları, ameliyat prosedürleri, tümör histopatolojik özellikleri, SLNÖ, ALND, USG bulguları kayıt altına alındı. USG ve SLNÖ arasındaki tanısal performans ölçütleri, USG-SLNÖ uyumuna etki eden faktörler analiz edildi. Bulgular: Olguların %97,3'ü T1, T2 kategorideki hastalardan oluşmaktadır. 338 olgunun tamamına SLNÖ yapılmıştır. 71'ine (%21) SLNÖ+ALND yapılmıştır. USG bulguları negatif olan 285 hastanın 67'sinde SLNÖ sonucunda metastaza rastlanmıştır (Negatif prediktif değer: %76,5). USG'nin sentinel lenf nodu metastazını saptamada %92 özgüllük, %33 duyarlılığa sahip olduğu görüldü. USG–SLNÖ uyumsuzluğu yüksek T kategorisi, lenfovasküler invazyon varlığı ve lobüler histoloji ile ilişkili bulundu. Oluşturulan nomogram ile T1 kategorisinde, LVI negatif olan hastalarda USG negatifliğinin en doğru sonuca ulaştığı görüldü. SLNÖ sonucu pozitif, USG'nin yanlış negatif olarak sınıflandırdığı hasta grubunun %80,6'sında 1-2 pozitif lenf nodu olduğu görüldü. Sonuç: Aksillaya cerrahi müdahalenin azaldığı güncel tedavi yaklaşımlarında doğru hasta seçiminin ve görüntülemenin önemi artmaktadır. Çalışmamız tüm hasta grubu içinde sentinel lenf nodu metastazlarını saptamada USG'nin tek başına yetersiz kalabileceğini gösteriyor. Kanser özellikleri değerlendirilip uygun hastalar seçildiğinde USG negatifliğinin doğruluğu önemli oranda artmaktadır. Daha fazla sayıda hasta ile farklı parametreler kullanılarak farklı klinik karar algoritmaları oluşturulabilir.

makaleler.baslik: Perineural versus intravenous dexmedetomidine as an adjuvant for ilioinguinal/iliohypogastric nerve block in open inguinal hernia repair: a randomised controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İnguinal Herni Onarımında Perinöral ve İntravenöz Dexmedetomidine Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 90 hastada yapılan tek merkezli RCT'de, inguinal herni onarımında perinöral dexmedetomidine, kontrol grubuna göre 6. saatte hareketle tetiklenen ağrıyı düşürürken (10,3'e karşı 22,0; p=0,018), intravenöz uygulama ağrıyı azaltmamış ve %20 oranında bradikardiye yol açmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Dexmedetomidine is widely added to peripheral nerve blocks, but whether the perineural or intravenous route provides better analgesia-and at what haemodynamic cost-is unclear in inguinal hernia repair. We compared the two routes as adjuncts to an ilioinguinal/iliohypogastric (II/IH) nerve block.
METHODS: This single-centre, triple-blind randomised controlled trial enrolled 90 adults (ASA I-III) undergoing elective open inguinal hernia repair. All received an ultrasound-guided II/IH block (0.5% bupivacaine with epinephrine, 20 mL) and standardised tumescent local anaesthesia, and were randomised 1:1:1 to perineural dexmedetomidine 1 µg/kg (DexLA), intravenous dexmedetomidine 1 µg/kg over 10 min (DexIV), or placebo (Control). The primary outcome was movement-evoked visual analogue scale (VAS, 0-100) pain at 6 h, analysed by intention-to-treat.
RESULTS: Movement VAS at 6 h was lower with perineural dexmedetomidine (DexLA 10.3 ± 10.3) than DexIV (20.0 ± 17.4) or Control (22.0 ± 20.6; overall p = 0.018): DexLA versus Control - 11.7 (95% CI - 21.9 to - 1.4; p = 0.022), whereas DexIV did not differ from Control (p = 0.888). This reduction reached the established minimum clinically important difference of approximately 10 points, although pain was low overall. Time to first opioid was similar (p = 0.723). Bradycardia was more frequent with DexIV (20.0%) than DexLA (3.3%) or Control (6.7%; DexIV vs DexLA p = 0.040); hypotension occurred in 43.3%, 40.0% and 20.0% (p = 0.151).
CONCLUSION: Perineural-but not intravenous-dexmedetomidine produced a clinically relevant reduction in early movement-evoked pain, whereas intravenous dexmedetomidine added bradycardia without analgesic benefit. If dexmedetomidine is used in this setting, the perineural route is preferable.

makaleler.baslik: Environmental Justice Index and 30-Day Wound Morbidity After Ventral Hernia Repair.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Ventral Herni Onarımı Sonrası Çevresel Adalet İndeksi ve Yara Morbiditesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 35626 hastayı içeren retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, genel çevresel adalet indeksinin yara morbiditesi ile ilişkisi incelenmiştir. Sosyal kırılganlık, SSO (OR 1,06; %95 CI 1,02-1,10) ve SSOPI (OR 1,09; %95 CI 1,05-1,14) ile ilişkili bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Place-based vulnerability may contribute to wound morbidity after ventral hernia repair (VHR), but the relevance of multidomain Environmental Justice Index (EJI) rankings is uncertain. We evaluated associations between overall and module-specific EJI rankings and 30-day wound outcomes.
STUDY DESIGN: This retrospective cohort study included 35,626 patients undergoing clean VHR with hernia width ≤18 cm in the Abdominal Core Health Quality Collaborative. Parastomal hernias and repairs involving anterior component separation were excluded. Overall EJI and social, environmental, health, and climate module rankings were modeled per 0.1-point increase. Multivariable logistic regression with institution-clustered robust standard errors evaluated surgical site infection (SSI), surgical site occurrence (SSO), and SSO requiring procedural intervention (SSOPI), adjusting for patient, hernia, and operative characteristics.
RESULTS: SSI, SSO, and SSOPI occurred in 1.9%, 8.1%, and 1.8%, respectively. Overall EJI was associated with SSOPI (OR 1.05, 95% CI 1.01-1.09), but not SSI or SSO. Social vulnerability was associated with SSO (OR 1.06, 95% CI 1.02-1.10) and SSOPI (OR 1.09, 95% CI 1.05-1.14). Health vulnerability was associated with SSI (OR 1.03, 95% CI 1.00-1.07), whereas climate burden was inversely associated with SSI (OR 0.95, 95% CI 0.91-0.99). Highest-versus-lowest EJI stratum absolute risk differences were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: Social vulnerability demonstrated the most consistent association with wound morbidity after VHR. EJI may provide complementary contextual information for perioperative assessment, but modest absolute differences do not support its use as a standalone clinical decision tool.

makaleler.baslik: Patient-reported Outcomes According to Mesh Position After Elective Incisional Hernia Repair: A Nationwide Survey- and Register-based Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İnsizyonel Herni Onarımında Mesh Yerleşimine Göre Hasta Bildirimli Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2827 hastanın katıldığı ulusal çalışmada, onlay mesh yerleşimi retromüsküler pozisyona kıyasla daha yüksek yabancı cisim hissiyatı ile ilişkili bulunmuştur (%37,1'e karşı %30,3; fark %6,8; %95 CI 0,9-12,8). Şiddetli kronik ağrı veya nüks açısından fark görülmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study was to investigate the association between mesh position and patient-reported outcomes, including prevalence of severe chronic pain, foreign body sensation, self-reported recurrence, and physical impact score in patients undergoing elective incisional hernia repair.
BACKGROUND: Patient-reported outcomes are increasingly recognized as important measures of treatment success following incisional hernia repair, yet the impact of mesh position remains uncertain.
METHODS: This nationwide Danish survey- and register-based cohort study was conducted within the AFTERHERNIA Project and based on the Abdominal Hernia questionnaire. All patients undergoing elective incisional hernia repair in Denmark between January 1, 2014, and March 31, 2024, were eligible for inclusion. Survey responses were linked with operative data from the Danish Ventral Hernia Database. Adjusted prevalences and means were estimated using g-computation.
RESULTS: Of 2827 eligible patients, 2348 patients responded, corresponding to a response rate of 83%. Among these, 28% of patients received onlay, 28% retromuscular, 13% preperitoneal, and 31% intraperitoneal mesh position with defect closure. Onlay was associated with a higher prevalence of foreign body sensation compared with retromuscular position (adjusted prevalence, 37.1% vs. 30.3%; difference, 6.8%; 95% CI, 0.9-12.8). No differences were observed across mesh positions regarding the prevalence of severe chronic pain, self-reported recurrence, and physical impact score.
CONCLUSIONS: Onlay position was associated with a higher prevalence of foreign body sensation compared with retromuscular position, while no differences were observed regarding the prevalence of severe chronic pain, self-reported recurrence, or physical impact score.

makaleler.baslik: Incisional hernia prevention in high-risk midline laparotomy using onlay PVDF mesh: multicenter prospective observational study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yüksek Riskli Laparotomide Onlay PVDF Mesh ile İnsizyonel Herni Önlenmesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 180 hastanın dahil olduğu prospektif gözlemsel çalışmada, profilaktik onlay PVDF mesh kullanımı %11,3 insizyonel herni oranı ile ilişkilendirilmiştir. BMI (OR 1,19; p=0,008) ve stoma varlığı (OR 5,77; p=0,004) herni ile bağımsız olarak ilişkili bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Prophylactic mesh reinforcement reduces the risk of incisional hernia after midline laparotomy in high-risk patients, although concerns regarding complications and implementation limit its routine use. This multicentre prospective observational study evaluated long-term outcomes after onlay polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) mesh reinforcement in high-risk patients undergoing midline laparotomy in elective and emergency settings.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A prospective multicentre observational cohort study was conducted in tertiary and secondary hospitals within the Spanish National Health Service between July 2016 and June 2022. Adult patients undergoing midline laparotomy with more than one risk factor for incisional hernia were included. Abdominal wall closure was reinforced with an onlay PVDF mesh visible on MRI. The primary outcome was incisional hernia at 2 years. Secondary outcomes included mesh-related complications and factors associated with incisional hernia.
RESULTS: A total of 180 patients were analysed. Mean age was 64.6 years and mean BMI was 27.4 kg/m2. Most procedures were performed for oncological disease (72.8%), 32.8% were emergency operations, and 23.9% were performed in contaminated or dirty surgical fields. Surgical-site infection occurred in 12.8% and seroma in 9.4% during index admission. Mesh removal was required in four patients (2.2%). Two-year follow-up among surviving patients reached 96.1%. In the intention-to-treat analysis, incisional hernia developed in 21 patients (11.3%), compared with 16 patients (8.9%) in the per-protocol analysis. BMI (OR 1.19, 95% c.i. 1.05 to 1.33; P = 0.008) and stoma formation (OR 5.77, 95% c.i. 1.75 to 19.30; P = 0.004) were independently associated with incisional hernia. MRI demonstrated no significant mesh contraction.
CONCLUSION: In this prospective multicentre observational study, prophylactic onlay PVDF mesh reinforcement in high-risk midline laparotomy, including emergency and contaminated procedures, was feasible and associated with a low incidence of incisional hernia and acceptable mesh-related morbidity. These findings are hypothesis-generating and warrant further evaluation in controlled studies.

makaleler.baslik: Who's paying? Payor status significantly affects hospital readmission rates after ventral hernia repair.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Ventral Herni Onarımı Sonrası Ödeme Statüsünün Hastane Tekrar Yatışına Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Retrospektif veritabanı incelemesinde, özel sigortaya sahip hastaların Medicaid hastalarına kıyasla otuz günlük tekrar yatış olasılığının daha düşük olduğu saptanmıştır (OR 0,71; p<0,001). En yaygın tekrar yatış nedeni postoperatif/cihaz enfeksiyonu olmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Over 350,000 ventral hernia repairs (VHRs) are performed annually. However, there are numerous socioeconomic disparities in obtaining elective repair. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of payer status after ventral hernia repair within a national cohort on thirty-day readmission rates, hospital costs, and discharge disposition.
METHODS: A retrospective chart review was conducted of the Nationwide Readmission Database (NRD) for all VHRs between 2016 and 2022. Demographic characteristics along with medical comorbidities, complications after VHR, and all-cause 30-day readmissions were collected. Logistic regression was used to assess associations between payer status and overall outcomes.
RESULTS: Medicaid (12.1%) and Medicare (12.4%) were the primary payer statuses among all readmissions. Patients with private insurance (OR 0.71, p < 0.001) and self-pay (OR 0.81, p < 0.001) had lower odds of thirty-day readmission compared to Medicaid patients. Patients discharged to a short-term facility, designated center, home healthcare, or against medical advice were more likely to be re-admitted compared to patients who were discharged home (p < 0.05). The most common cause for re-admission among all patients was post-operative/device infection. Medicaid patients had the highest rate of such infections (2.20 vs. 1.68 Medicare, 1.45 Private, and 1.56 Self-Pay).
CONCLUSIONS: Payer status significantly influences readmission rates, cause for readmission, and overall discharge disposition among VHR patients. These findings might implicate underlying socioeconomic disparities in receiving adequate post-operative care. Future studies should investigate how insurance structures impact postoperative care and clinical outcomes in hernia surgery.

tez.baslik: İnguinal herni cerrahisinde farklı cerrahi yaklaşımların değerlendirilmesi: Deneyimlerimiz ve klinik sonuçlarımız
tez.baslik_tr: İnguinal Herni Cerrahisinde Cerrahi Yaklaşımların Değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: 1628 inguinal herni ameliyatının retrospektif incelendiği tez çalışmasında, 1418 hasta açık (Lichtenstein) ve 192 hasta laparoskopik yöntemlerle opere edildi. Erken komplikasyon gelişen hastalarda VAS değerlerinin istatistiksel olarak daha yüksek olduğu saptandı.
tez.ozet: ÇINAR A., İNGUİNAL HERNİ CERRAHİSİNDE FARKLI CERRAHİ YAKLAŞIMLARIN DEĞERLENDİRİLMESİ: DENEYİMLERİMİZ VE KLİNİK SONUÇLARIMIZ, GAZİANTEP ÜNİVERSİTESİ TIP FAKÜLTESİ, GENEL CERRAHİ ANABİLİM DALI, TIPTA UZMANLIK TEZİ, GAZİANTEP, 2026. Amaç: Dünya genelinde genel cerrahi kliniklerine en sık başvuru nedenlerinden olan inguinal herniler, semptomatik veya rastlantısal olarak teşhis edilebilmektedir. Çalışmamızda, inguinal herni onarımında uygulanan açık onarım ile laparoskopik (TAPP, TEP) ve laparotomi yöntemlerinin; operasyon süreleri, hastanede yatış, işe dönüş, ağrı skorları ve nüks gibi komplikasyonlar açısından karşılaştırılarak, cerrahlara güncel veriler ışığında klinik öneriler sunulması amaçlanmaktadır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Çalışmamız Gaziantep Üniversitesi Şahinbey Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde Ekim 2012-Haziran 2025 yılları arasında yapılan 1628 inguinal herni ameliyatı retrospekif incelenerek yapılmıştır. Bulgular: Hastaların 1418 tanesi açık cerrahi yöntem (Lichtenstein) ile 192 tanesi laparoskopik yöntemler kullanılarak ve 18 tanesi orta hat insizyon yaklaşımıyla yapıldı. Katılımcıların 85 (% 5,2) tanesinin kadın, 1543 (% 94,8) tanesinin erkek olduğu, fıtık lokalizasyonuna bakıldığında vakaların 893 (% 54,9) tanesinin sağ taraftan, 654 (% 40,2) katılımcının sol taraftan, 81 (% 5,0) katılımcının ise bilateral opere edildiği görüldü. VAS değişkeninin, seroma ve ağrı haricinde kalan tüm erken komplikasyon türlerine göre istatistiki olarak anlamlı şekilde farklılaştığı görülmüştür (p<0,05). Farklılaşmanın sebeplerine bakıldığında; erken komplikasyon olmayan katılımcıların VAS değerlerinin daha düşük olmasına karşın hematom, ekimoz, yara yeri enfeksiyonu (YYE), hidrosel, inkontinans ve diğer erken komplikasyon türleri olan katılımcılarda ise VAS değerlerinin daha yüksek olduğu görülmüştür. Sonuç: Çalışmamız ve literatür verilerine bakarsak, laparoskopik onarımın güvenli ve efektif olduğunu kanıtlanmaktadır. Minimal invaziv yapısı, kısa yatış süresi, hızlı iyileşme ve ek fıtıkları saptama avantajları nedeniyle; bu yöntemin inguinal herni tedavisinde birçok merkezde giderek artan oranda öncelikli tercih haline geleceğini öngörmekteyiz. Anahtar kelimeler: Lichtenstein, laparatomi, mesh, TAPP, TEP

makaleler.baslik: Impact of Donor Obesity on Outcomes in Living Donor Liver Transplantation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Canlı Donör Karaciğer Transplantasyonunda Donör Obezitesinin Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 6652 donörü içeren 9 karşılaştırmalı kohortun meta-analizinde, donör obezitesi genel komplikasyonları artırmazken, yara komplikasyonları (RR 2,05; p=0,012) ve hastaneye yeniden yatış oranını (RR 1,34; p=0,026) artırmıştır. Alıcı sağkalımı ve safra komplikasyonları benzer bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Living donor liver transplantation increasingly faces the question of whether otherwise healthy candidates with a body mass index ≥30 kg/m2 can be safely accepted. Available evidence is uneven: large registry datasets sit alongside heterogeneous single-center series, none quantifying the risk accepted by the donors themselves. We therefore synthesized contemporary comparative evidence in living donor liver transplantation, evaluating donor obesity against donor, recipient, and graft outcomes.
METHODS: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar from January 2000 to June 30, 2026, for comparative cohorts of living liver donors reporting donor and recipient outcomes by donor body mass index (≥30 versus <30 kg/m2). Random-effects meta-analysis used restricted maximum likelihood with Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman 95% confidence intervals (CIs); risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed with Risk Of Bias In Nonrandomized Studies of Interventions and Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation.
RESULTS: Nine comparative cohorts comprising 6652 donors from North America, Europe, and Asia were included. Donor obesity was not associated with overall complications (risk ratio [RR], 1.09; 95% CI, 0.89-1.34; P = 0.31) or major complications (RR, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.62-1.67; P = 0.93). However, obese donors had higher rates of wound complications (RR, 2.05; 95% CI, 1.25-3.37; P = 0.012) and hospital readmission (RR, 1.34; 95% CI, 1.07-1.69; P = 0.026). Recipient 1-y patient survival, graft survival, and biliary complications were comparable.
CONCLUSIONS: In carefully screened candidates, obesity alone should not preclude living liver donation. The excess wound morbidity and readmission argue for enhanced prophylaxis and surveillance after discharge rather than for donor exclusion.

makaleler.baslik: Kidney donor profile index (KDPI) score and long-term deceased donor kidney transplant outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort studies.
makaleler.baslik_tr: KDPI Skoru ve Uzun Dönem Kadavra Böbrek Nakli Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2902 alıcıyı içeren 5 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, KDPI skorundaki her 10 puanlık artış ölüm dışlanmış greft yetmezliği oranında artışla ilişki bulunmuştur (HR 1,19, %95 CI 1,08-1,31). KDPI yüksek donörlerde uzun dönem greft sonuçları daha kötü olmakla birlikte ayırt edici gücü sınırlıdır.
makaleler.ozet: The Kidney Donor Profile Index (KDPI) summarizes the expected longevity of deceased-donor kidneys, but its relationship with long-term graft outcomes and its performance outside the United States remain uncertain. We systematically reviewed cohort evidence evaluating KDPI and long-term deceased-donor kidney transplant outcomes. MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CENTRAL, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from January 2014 through June 2026. Eligible studies included at least 100 adult deceased-donor kidney recipients with outcomes assessed at a minimum three-year horizon. Adjusted hazard ratios (HRs) for death-censored graft failure were standardized to a 10-point KDPI increase and pooled using a random-effects model with restricted maximum likelihood and modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Thirteen publications were included; five studies comprising 2902 recipients contributed comparable adjusted estimates. Each 10-point increase in KDPI was associated with a higher rate of death-censored graft failure (HR 1.19, 95% CI 1.08-1.31; I2 = 43.8%; 95% prediction interval 0.97-1.46). Restriction to three studies with explicit long-term follow-up yielded HR 1.14 (95% CI 1.02-1.27; I2 = 14.2%). The exploratory KDPI >85% analysis was imprecise (HR 2.13, 95% CI 0.75-6.02). Reported KDPI discrimination was generally limited, with C-statistics around 0.54-0.62. Higher KDPI is associated with worse long-term death-censored graft outcomes, but effect magnitude varies across settings and KDPI alone has limited discriminatory ability. Local validation and periodic recalibration remain important.

makaleler.baslik: Liver Transplantation for Unresectable Colorectal Liver Metastases: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Survival Outcomes.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rezeke Edilemeyen Kolorektal Karaciğer Metastazlarında Karaciğer Nakli
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Rezeke edilemeyen kolorektal karaciğer metastazlarında karaciğer naklini değerlendiren 17 çalışmalık meta-analizde, nakil alternatif tedavilere kıyasla sağkalım avantajı sağlamıştır (HR 0,45; %95 CI 0,28-0,72; P=0,0009).
makaleler.ozet: Palliative chemotherapy for unresectable colorectal liver metastases (uCRLM) yields poor long-term survival. Liver transplantation (LT) is an emerging curative option for highly selected patients with liver-only disease. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA guidelines. Electronic databases were searched for studies evaluating LT for uCRLM. Overall survival (OS) from comparative studies was pooled using random-effects models. Risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane RoB 2 and ROBINS-I V2. Potential patient overlap between cohorts from the same transplant programs was assessed and, where present, only 1 report per cohort contributed to pooling. Seventeen studies were included, with 3 comparative studies providing data for meta-analysis. Pooled analysis favored LT over best alternative therapies (HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.28-0.72; P = .0009; I² = 3%). This estimate was not robust: the TransMet randomized trial contributed 63% of the pooled weight, and its exclusion rendered the effect nonsignificant (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.30-1.35). Comparators were clinically heterogeneous, spanning chemotherapy alone, mixed best alternative therapy, and ALPPS, so the pooled hazard ratio should not be read as a single transferable estimate of transplant benefit. Narrative synthesis indicated 5-year OS rates reached 83% following strict biological selection. Post-transplant recurrence was frequent (72%-81.5%) but often amenable to curative-intent management. Referral data, available only from a conference abstract, suggest that approximately 10% of evaluated patients ultimately undergo LT. In highly selected patients with permanently unresectable, liver-confined CRLM, LT is associated with a survival advantage, although the pooled estimate rests principally on a single randomized trial and should not be generalized across the clinically distinct comparators from which it was derived. The benefit appears to be driven by identifying a ``biological elite'' through stringent selection and aggressive multidisciplinary management of recurrences. PROSPERO registration: CRD42025124542.

makaleler.baslik: SETI-The Semi-Elective Transplant Initiative: A Systems-Based Approach to Expanding Kidney Transplant Access Through Operational Redesign.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Nakli Erişimini Genişletmede Operasyonel Yeniden Tasarım Yaklaşımı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 936 nakil yapılan çalışmada operasyonel yeniden tasarım sonrası ortalama cold ischemia time 20,2 saatten 21,9 saate yükselmiştir (p=0,0039). DGF (%41,4'ten %38,2'ye, p=0,071) ve greft yetmezliğinde anlamlı fark görülmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether formal integration of preservation strategy with predictable operating room access was associated with measurable changes in transplant timing, preservation practice, the logistical profile of transplanted grafts, and early clinical outcomes.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Deceased donor kidney transplantation remains a reactive process requiring urgent mobilization of hospital resources. As volumes increase and hospitals operate near capacity, this creates operational barriers that limit organ utilization. We report a retrospective evaluation of a prospectively implemented operational redesign; the design does not support causal inference.
METHODS: Adult deceased-donor kidney transplants (January 2022-June 2025) were grouped into pre-SETI, SETI-1 (expanded machine perfusion), and SETI-2 (morning operating room access). A contemporaneous SRTR cohort (N=12,302) served as the comparator.
RESULTS: Among 936 transplants, mean cold ischemia time (CIT) increased after SETI (20.2→21.9 h, P=0.0039). Donation after circulatory death (DCD) kidneys with CIT >30 hours increased from 0.5% pre-SETI to 7.7% after full implementation (P<0.0001). Overnight perfusion increased more than 3-fold, and operative starts shifted toward 8-10 AM. Kidney Donor Profile Index rose across eras (median: 29→33→43, P<0.001). No significant differences were observed in DGF (41.4→38.2%, P=0.071) or graft failure (5.4→3.2%, P=0.34); these comparisons were underpowered and do not establish equivalence. Donor hypertension predicted graft failure, whereas CIT, DCD status, and SETI era did not.
CONCLUSIONS: Systems-based operational redesign transformed reactive deceased-donor kidney transplantation into a proactive model, enabling transplantation of a greater proportion of logistics-sensitive grafts, including DCD kidneys and organs with prolonged CIT, within existing healthcare resources. Whether this increases net organ utilization was not established by these data.

makaleler.baslik: Outcomes of renal transplantation in Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Afrika'da Renal Transplantasyon Sonuçları: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 3617 katılımcıyı içeren 16 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, alıcılarda havuzlanmış mortalite %14,3 olarak saptanmıştır. 1 ve 5 yıllık greft sağkalımı sırasıyla %91,74 ve %69,15, hasta sağkalımı ise %94,72 ve %81,26 olarak bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Although transplantation is considered a treatment for end-stage renal disease, data on post-transplant outcomes remain fragmented.
OBJECTIVE: This study aims to assess the outcomes of renal transplantation in Africa.
DESIGN: Studies were searched in MEDLINE, EMBASE, CINAHL, Scopus, Google Scholar, the Transplantation Library, and African Journals Online. A random-effects model was employed to calculate the pooled effect size of each outcome. Heterogeneity was assessed with the I 2 test, and publication bias was evaluated using Egger's regression test. Trim-and-fill analysis was employed to manage publication bias. The protocol was registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews.
STUDIES: Studies conducted in Africa.
PARTICIPANTS: In this study, 16 articles were included, with a total of 3617 participants.
RESULT: Pooled mortality among renal transplant recipients was 14.3% (95% CI: 8.77%-19.84%). Graft survival rates at 1 and 5 years were 91.74% (95% CI: 88.56%-94.93%) and 69.15% (95% CI: 57.39%-80.91%), respectively. Patient survival at 1 and 5 years was 94.72% (95% CI: 92.17%-97.26%) and 81.26% (95% CI: 72.11%-90.4%), respectively. Diabetes mellitus, delayed graft function, acute rejection, and infection were observed as post-transplantation complications.
CONCLUSION: With a few important exceptions, both graft and patient survival were comparable to reports from other nations. Thus, we recommend that clinical practitioners prioritize infection prevention and early screening for complications. Furthermore, policymakers should develop and implement strategies to prevent and screen for post-transplant complications, and improve the accessibility of the service.

tez.baslik: Erişkin canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde transanastomotik internal stent kullanımı postoperatif biliyer komplikasyonları azaltmak için güvenilir bir seçenek midir? Sonuçlarımızın literatür ile karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Naklinde Transanastomotik Stent Kullanımı
tez.kisa_ozet: 64 erişkin canlı vericili karaciğer nakli hastasını içeren retrospektif çalışmada, transanastomotik internal stent kullanımı ile toplam biliyer komplikasyon oranı %15,5 olarak saptanmıştır.
tez.ozet: AMAÇ: Bu çalışmanın amacı, erişkin canlı vericili karaciğer nakli uygulanan hastalarda transanastomotik internal stent kullanımının postoperatif biliyer komplikasyonlar üzerindeki etkisini değerlendirmek ve elde edilen sonuçları literatür verileri ile karşılaştırmaktır. YÖNTEM: Bu retrospektif çalışmaya, Mayıs 2023 – Kasım 2025 tarihleri arasında erişkin canlı vericili karaciğer nakli uygulanan toplam 64 hasta dahil edildi. Erken dönem mortalite gelişen ve biliyer komplikasyon açısından değerlendirme dışı bırakılan 6 hasta hariç tutularak, biliyer komplikasyon analizi 58 hasta üzerinden gerçekleştirildi. Tüm hastalarda biliyer rekonstrüksiyon sırasında transanastomotik internal stent kullanıldı. Biliyer komplikasyonlar erken ve geç dönem olarak sınıflandırıldı. Biliyer kaçaklar bilioma şeklinde tanımlandı. Demografik veriler, preoperatif klinik özellikler, intraoperatif parametreler ve postoperatif sonuçlar kaydedildi. Biliyer komplikasyon gelişen ve gelişmeyen hastalar karşılaştırıldı. İstatistiksel analizler SPSS yazılımı kullanılarak gerçekleştirildi ve p<0,05 değeri istatistiksel anlamlılık sınırı olarak kabul edildi. BULGULAR: Çalışmaya dahil edilen 58 hastada toplam biliyer komplikasyon oranı %15,5 olarak saptandı. Erken dönem biliyer komplikasyon oranı %5,2, geç dönem biliyer komplikasyon oranı %12,1 idi. Erken dönemde gelişen biliyer komplikasyonların tamamı bilioma şeklinde olup, perkütan drenaj kateteri ile başarılı şekilde kontrol altına alındı. Geç dönemde 6 hastada biliyer striktür, 1 hastada biliyer fistüle bağlı bilioma gelişti. Biliyer striktür gelişen hastaların tamamında PTK veya ERCP ile internal stent uygulanarak komplikasyonlar kontrol altına alındı. 1 hastada tekrarlayan girişimlere rağmen devam eden biliyer fistül-bilioma ve buna bağlı gelişen biliyer sepsis sonucu geç dönem mortalite görüldü. Erken dönem mortalite gelişen 6 hastanın tamamı biliyer komplikasyon dışı nedenlerle kaybedildi. Biliyer komplikasyona bağlı mortalite oranı %1,7 olarak belirlendi. Biliyer komplikasyon gelişen ve gelişmeyen hastalar karşılaştırıldığında intraoperatif eritrosit süspansiyonu replasmanı (p=0,027) ve postoperatif hastanede yatış süresi (p=0,036) biliyer komplikasyon gelişimi ile anlamlı ilişkili bulundu. SONUÇ: Erişkin canlı vericili karaciğer naklinde transanastomotik internal stent kullanımı, biliyer komplikasyon oranlarının düşük düzeylerde seyretmesine katkı sağlamakta ve gelişen komplikasyonların büyük oranda girişimsel yöntemlerle kontrol altına alınmasına olanak tanımaktadır. Bu yaklaşım, uygun hasta seçimi ve deneyimli merkezlerde uygulanması koşuluyla, biliyer komplikasyonların azaltılmasına katkı sağlayabilecek güvenilir ve etkili bir cerrahi strateji olarak değerlendirilebilir. ANAHTAR SÖZCÜKLER: Canlı vericili karaciğer nakli, biliyer komplikasyonlar, transanastomotik internal stent, bilioma, biliyer striktür.

makaleler.baslik: Project international Delphi consensus recommendations for perioperative management of inguinal lymphadenectomy in cancer patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Inguinal Lenfadenektomi Perioperatif Yönetimi İçin Konsensus Önerileri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Yirmi beş ülkeden 101 uzmanın katıldığı bu Delphi çalışmasında, inguinal lenf nodu diseksiyonu komplikasyonlarının önlenmesi ve yönetimi için 86 klinik ifadeden 51'inde konsensusa varılmıştır. Öneriler; preoperatif beslenme optimizasyonu, anemi yönetimi, lenfatik ve yara komplikasyonları ile erken fonksiyonel rehabilitasyonu kapsamaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To establish international expert consensus on perioperative strategies for the prevention, management, and follow-up of complications related to inguinal lymph node dissection.
METHODS: This international modified Delphi consensus study was conducted between September 2025 and March 2026 using a 2-round electronic survey. A total of 101 experts from 25 countries participated, including urologists, surgical oncologists, plastic surgeons, and other specialists with experience in ILND for penile cancer, melanoma, and vulvar cancer. Eighty-six clinical statements addressing ILND-associated complications were evaluated across 6 domains: preoperative nutritional optimization, anemia management, lymphatic complications, infectious and cutaneous complications, vascular and musculoskeletal complications, and functional rehabilitation. Agreement was assessed using a 5-point Likert scale, with consensus defined a priori as at least 70% of participants selecting "somewhat agree" or "strongly agree."
RESULTS: Consensus was achieved for 51 of 86 statements. Agreed recommendations supported standardized approaches to preoperative nutritional assessment and anemia correction, prevention and management of lymphatic complications, drain placement and management, discharge criteria, antibiotic prophylaxis, wound complication management, thromboprophylaxis, multimodal analgesia, and early functional rehabilitation. No consensus was reached regarding routine use of immunonutrition, optimal duration of antibiotic therapy, topical treatments, muscle relaxants, or hyperbaric oxygen therapy.
CONCLUSIONS: This international Delphi process generated consensus-based, multidisciplinary recommendations to guide perioperative ILND management. These statements may provide a structured framework to support greater standardization of perioperative care pathways across malignancies requiring ILND, reduce morbidity, and inform quality-improvement initiatives. Prospective validation is required to evaluate their clinical impact and refine areas of ongoing uncertainty.

makaleler.baslik: Experience-based recommendations for the diagnosis and management of early-stage nail unit melanoma.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Erken Evre Tırnak Ünitesi Melanomu Tanı ve Yönetimi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Uluslararası bir uzman paneli tarafından erken evre tırnak ünitesi melanomu için pratik öneriler sunulmuştur. Tam cerrahi eksizyon temel tedavi olup, erken evrede standart lezyonlar için 6 mm ve Hutchinson bulgusu varlığında 10 mm geniş lokal eksizyon önerilmektedir; 1 mm'den kalın tümörler için ise genellikle amputasyon tercih edilmektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Nail unit melanoma (NUM) is a distinct form of melanoma that most often arises from the nail matrix. No recommendations as to the management of nail melanoma, particularly of early-stage melanoma (in situ, stage IA, IB), exist.
OBJECTIVES: To provide practical, experience-based recommendations for the diagnosis, differential diagnosis and management of early-stage NUM, developed by an international expert panel.
METHODS: Based on clinical and histopathological experience and an extensive literature search, the authors present recommendations for the management of patients with lesions suspicious for NUM.
RESULTS: Clinically, most cases present as a longitudinal pigmented band in an adult nail. It represents 1.5-2.5% of all melanomas in Caucasians but up to 50% in Black patients. Considering that the nail unit surface area accounts for less than 1% of the total body surface, the nail matrix can be regarded as a hotspot for melanoma development. Early diagnosis is critical, as treatment at the in situ or minimally invasive stage is associated with high cure rates. While dermoscopy is a useful diagnostic aid, nail matrix biopsy with histopathology remains the gold standard. Laboratory tests and standard imaging studies are not diagnostic; however, they may assist in surgical planning for advanced cases. Complete surgical excision is the treatment of choice. Wide local excision is recommended for early-stage disease, with specific margins (6 mm for standard lesions; 10 mm in the presence of the Hutchinson sign). Amputation is generally reserved for thicker tumours (>1 mm). A 10-year follow-up period is recommended to monitor for potential recurrence.
CONCLUSIONS: Early diagnosis and treatment of nail unit melanoma at the in situ or minimally invasive stage (IA/IB) are associated with high cure rates. In contrast, advanced disease with deep invasion or metastasis carries a poor prognosis-therefore, timely recognition and intervention are essential to optimize outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Can increased intraabdominal pressure augment the cytotoxicity of intraperitoneal chemotherapy during HIPEC? A systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HIPEC Sırasında Artan İntraabdominal Basınç Kemoterapi Sitotoksisitesini Artırır mı?
makaleler.kisa_ozet: İntraabdominal basınç artışının intraperitoneal kemoterapi etkinliğini artırıp artırmadığını inceleyen bu derlemede 6 çalışma incelenmiştir. Parietal peritoneal dokularda kemoterapi konsantrasyonunun artışının 1,4 ile 3,5 kat arasında değiştiği tahmin edilmiştir; ancak viseral peritoneal dokularda basınç nedeniyle anlamlı bir konsantrasyon artışı bildirilmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet: The utility of increased intraabdominal pressure to increase the efficacy of intraperitoneal was studied. All relevant studies published between 1996 and April of 2025 were reviewed. Six manuscripts from five different institutions were included for appraisal and data extraction. There was a single randomized trial in humans with all other data from rat or pig experiments. The pharmacokinetics of diffusion were determined to be unchanged by increased pressure. In all studies, the concentration of chemotherapy as it moved from the peritoneal space to the body compartment through the peritoneal-plasma barrier was regarded as a surrogate for cytotoxicity. At the completion of HIPEC, large differences in chemotherapy concentration when parietal peritoneum was compared to visceral peritoneum were reported in 4 of 6 studies. Four studies reported increased chemotherapy concentration in parietal peritoneal tissues with increased pressure, and 4 studies reported a small increase in chemotherapy concentration in visceral peritoneal tissues. Increased chemotherapy concentrations in peritoneal tissues caused by large volumes of chemotherapy infused into the peritoneal space can be the result of increased tissue concentrations from increased volume unrelated to increased pressure. A hypothesis to assist in data interpretation suggests that pressure increased the concentration of chemotherapy within the parietal peritoneal plasma barrier by expanding the permeability area. The increase in chemotherapy concentration in parietal peritoneal tissues was estimated at times 1.4 to 3.5. Visceral peritoneal tissues cannot be expanded by pressure so that little, if any, increased concentration of chemotherapy by pressure in these tissues was reported.

makaleler.baslik: The prognostic value of pathological response in soft tissue sarcoma: A systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yumuşak Doku Sarkomunda Patolojik Yanıtın Prognostik Değeri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Yirmi yedi çalışmadan 3961 hastanın incelendiği bu sistematik derlemede, patolojik yanıtın yumuşak doku sarkomunda güvenilir bir prognostik belirteç olduğu hipotezi değerlendirilmiştir. Düşük canlı tümör hücreleri vakaların %36'sında (9/25) iyileşmiş sağkalımı öngörürken, yüksek nekroz oranı vakaların %75'inde (6/8) azalmış sağkalımla ilişkilendirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pathological response (pR) has increasingly been used as a surrogate marker of neoadjuvant treatment efficacy in soft tissue sarcoma (STS), yet evidence linking it to improved survival remains inconsistent. This review evaluates the prognostic value of pR in neoadjuvant-treated STS.
METHODS: A systematic literature review identified clinical trials, observational studies, and retrospective studies assessing survival outcomes associated with pR, defined by residual viable tumour cells (RVT), necrosis, or fibrosis/hyalinization, in STS treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or chemoradiotherapy. Results were reported narratively given substantial heterogeneity between studies.
RESULTS: Twenty-seven studies comprising 3961 patients (median 112, range 50-496) were included. Twenty-five reported RVT, eight necrosis, and seven fibrosis/hyalinization. Considerable variability was observed in the prognostic value of pR across studies. Low RVT predicted improved survival in 36% (9/25), high necrosis predicted decreased survival in 75% (6/8), and fibrosis/hyalinization was inconsistent (43% favourable, 29% unfavourable). Cut-off values, histological parameters and definitions, and patient and treatment characteristics varied widely. Analyses were predominantly unadjusted for confounders, including tumour grade, histological subtype, and resection margin.
CONCLUSIONS: Current evidence is insufficient to support pR as a reliable prognostic predictor. The prognostic value of RVT, necrosis, and fibrosis/hyalinization varies substantially across studies, likely reflecting differences in histological subtype, tumour biology, treatment heterogeneity, and methodological inconsistencies in pR assessment. Standardisation of histological parameters assessed, their definitions, and pR categorisation criteria is required to determine the prognostic relevance of pR in STS. The proposed CHIRE framework provides a practical foundation for harmonising pR assessment and reporting in future STS studies.

makaleler.baslik: Long-term survival after HIPEC with mitomycin C versus oxaliplatin in patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal Peritoneal Metastazda HIPEC: Mitomisin C ve Oksaliplatin Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 366 hastanın dahil olduğu retrospektif çalışmada, oxaliplatin bazlı HIPEC, mitomisin C bazlı HIPEC'e kıyasla daha kötü peritoneal hastalıksız sağkalım ile ilişkili bulundu (medyan 11,3 aya karşı 14,9 ay; HR 1,44; p=0,010). Sistemik oxaliplatin öyküsü olanlarda oxaliplatin bazlı HIPEC, peritoneal hastalıksız sağkalımı (medyan 8,7 aya karşı 13,1 ay; HR 1,59; p=0,014) ve genel sağkalımı (medyan 35,7 aya karşı 50,6 ay; HR 1,55; p=0,020) olumsuz etkiledi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) and oxaliplatin-based hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is controversial in patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases, particularly in those who have received prior systemic oxaliplatin. In the Netherlands, upfront CRS-HIPEC remains the preferred treatment. The aim was to compare the survival of patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases treated with CRS and mitomycin C versus oxaliplatin-based HIPEC.
METHODS: This was a retrospective, single-center cohort study of consecutive patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases who underwent macroscopic complete CRS-HIPEC between 2010 and 2023. Main outcomes were differences in disease-free, peritoneal disease-free, distant disease-free, and overall survival.
RESULTS: Of 366 patients included, 153 and 213 underwent mitomycin C-based and oxaliplatin-based HIPEC, respectively. Most patients (68.6%) underwent upfront CRS-HIPEC. Median follow-up was 58.7 months (range, 24.8 - 175.1) and median overall survival was 43.3 months (95% CI, 36.5 - 49.9). In multivariable analyses, oxaliplatin-based HIPEC was associated with worse peritoneal disease-free survival compared to mitomycin C-based HIPEC (median 11.3 vs. 14.9 months; HR 1.44, 95% CI, 1.09 - 1.90; P = .010). No difference was observed in disease-free, distant disease-free, and overall survival. Among patients treated with oxaliplatin-based HIPEC, prior systemic oxaliplatin exposure was associated with worse peritoneal disease-free survival (median 8.7 vs. 13.1 months; HR 1.59, 95% CI, 1.10 - 2.31; P = .014) and overall survival (median 35.7 vs. 50.6 months; HR 1.55, 95% CI, 1.07 - 2.23; P = .020) compared to no prior oxaliplatin exposure.
CONCLUSIONS: Oxaliplatin-based HIPEC was associated with a higher risk of peritoneal recurrence, particularly in patients previously treated with systemic oxaliplatin. Mitomycin C-based HIPEC is a better choice in this subgroup.

tez.baslik: Postoperatif peritoneal adezyon modelinde Nigella sativa L. ve E vitamini etkinliğinin karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Peritoneal Adezyon Modelinde Nigella sativa L. ve E Vitamininin Karşılaştırılması
tez.kisa_ozet: 36 Wistar sıçan üzerinde yapılan bu deneysel çalışmada, adezyon skorları gruplar arasında anlamlı fark göstermedi (p=0,680). Histopatolojik değerlendirmede E vitamini grubunda Nigella sativa grubuna kıyasla azalmış fibrozis ve enflamasyon tespit edildi (p<0,001). E vitamininin enflamasyon ve fibrozisi azaltmada daha üstün olduğu sonucuna varıldı.
tez.ozet: Bu çalışmada, sıçan adezyon modelinde lokal olarak uygulanan Nigella sativa L. yağı ve E vitamininin etkinliğininin karşılaştırması amaçlanmıştır. Otuz altı erkek Wistar sıçan (90 günlük, 240 ± 37 g) üç gruba ayrıldı: kontrol grubu (steril salin), 10 mg/kg TQ içeren N. sativa yağı grubu (NS) (0.16 - 0.24 mL/rat) ve 50 mg/kg tokoferol içeren E vitamini grubu (vit E) (0.06 - 0.1 mL/rat). İntraabdominal adezyon indüklendikten sonra tedaviler intraperitoneal olarak uygulandı. Sekizinci günde ratlara ötenazi uygulandı ve adezyonlar makroskobik olarak skorlandı. Interlökin-6 (IL-6), Tümör Nekroz Faktör-alfa (TNF-α), Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), Transforme Büyüme Faktörü-beta 1 (TGF-β1), Vasküler Endoteliyal Büyüme Faktörü (VEGF), Interlökin-10 (IL-10) ve Interlökin-1 beta (IL-1β) düzeyleri ölçüldü; histopatolojik değerlendirme ve Picro-Sirius Red boyaması yapıldı. Adezyon skorları gruplar arasında anlamlı fark göstermedi (p = 0.680). TNF-α düzeyleri, kontrol grubunda vit E grubuna kıyasla anlamlı derecede yüksekti (p = 0.011), ancak NS ile vit E grupları arasında fark yoktu. PGE2 düzeyleri NS ve vit E grupları arasında anlamlı farklılık gösterdi (p = 0.023). IL-1β, IL-6, IL-10, TGF-β1 ve VEGF düzeylerinde anlamlı farklılık gözlenmedi (p > 0.05). Histopatolojide, vit E grubunda NS grubuna kıyasla azalmış fibrozis ve enflamasyon tespit edildi (p < 0.001). Picro-Sirius Red boyaması, vit E grubunda daha iyi kollajen olgunlaşması olduğunu gösterdi; NS grubu ikinci sırada yer alırken, kontrol grubunda daha az olgun kollajen gözlendi. Sonuç olarak, her iki tedavi etkili olsa da vit E, enflamasyon ve fibrozisi azaltmada ve kollajen olgunlaşmasını iyileştirmede daha üstün bulunmuştur. Anahtar Kelimeler: Doku adezyonu, enflamasyon, kollajen, periton, vitaminler.

makaleler.baslik: Diagnostic accuracy of the appendicitis inflammatory response (AIR) score for acute appendicitis during pregnancy: A systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Gebelerde akut apandisit için AIR skorunun tanısal doğruluğu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Beş çalışmanın incelendiği bu sistematik derleme ve meta-analizde, gebelikte akut apandisit için Appendicitis Inflammatory Response (AIR) skorunun havuzlanmış duyarlılığı %66,7 ve özgüllüğü %75,5 (AUC=0,752) bulunmuştur. Eşik değer seçimi tanısal performansı önemli ölçüde etkilemektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: This diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis evaluated the accuracy of the Appendicitis Inflammatory Response (AIR) score for acute appendicitis (AA) in pregnant women.
METHODS: Following PRISMA guidance, PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from inception through March 2026 for studies providing data to construct 2 × 2 contingency tables. Pooled sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC) were estimated using a bivariate random-effects Reitsma model. Methodological quality was assessed using QUADAS-2. Meta-regression explored AIR cutoff, disease prevalence, and reference-standard category as potential sources of heterogeneity.
RESULTS: Five studies met the eligibility criteria. The pooled sensitivity was 66.7% (95% CI: 44.2-83.5%) and specificity was 75.5% (95% CI: 40.0-93.5%), with a false-positive rate of 24.5% (95% CI: 6.5-60.0%). Overall diagnostic accuracy was moderate (AUC = 0.752; normalized pAUC = 0.669). Substantial heterogeneity was observed (Zhou-Dendukuri I² = 75.6%). AIR cutoff significantly moderated specificity (P < 0.001), but not sensitivity (P = 0.911). In a within-study analysis, increasing the cutoff from ≥4 to ≥9 reduced sensitivity from 99.1% to 36.8% and increased specificity from 42.4% to 97.0%.
CONCLUSIONS: The AIR score provides moderate accuracy for AA in pregnancy and should be used as an adjunct to clinical assessment rather than as a stand-alone diagnostic tool. Threshold selection contributes to variability in diagnostic performance. Prospective multicenter studies are needed to establish pregnancy-specific cutoffs.

makaleler.baslik: Acute management of pelvic ring injuries: identifying common treatment principles across institutional algorithms.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pelvis halkası yaralanmalarının akut yönetimi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 25 çalışmanın analiz edildiği sistematik derlemede, pelvis yaralanmalarına yönelik tüm algoritmalarda fizyoloji temelli karar verme ve erken noninvaziv mekanik stabilizasyonun (%92) temel alındığı gösterilmiştir. Olguların %76'sında anjiyografi ve %80'inde pelvik paketleme yer almıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Pelvic ring injuries are associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, particularly in patients presenting with hemodynamic instability and major hemorrhage. Numerous institutions have developed management algorithms for the acute treatment of pelvic ring injuries; however, the common principles underlying these pathways remain unclear.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus were searched on January 8, 2026, for peer-reviewed publications published from January 1, 2006, through December 31, 2025 that described algorithms, pathways, or protocols for the acute management of pelvic ring injuries. Two independent reviewers performed study selection and data extraction. Algorithm components related to mechanical stabilization, physiologic assessment, imaging, hemorrhage control, and damage control resuscitation were extracted and compared using descriptive quantitative and qualitative synthesis.
RESULTS: The search identified 328 records that underwent title and abstract screening, and 63 articles were assessed for full-text eligibility. Twenty-five studies were included in the final analysis. All included algorithms (25/25, 100%) used physiology-based decision-making. Early noninvasive mechanical stabilization was specified in 23/25 algorithms (92%); pelvic binders were specified in 17/25 (68%). Angiography with potential angioembolization was included in 19/25 algorithms (76%), exploratory laparotomy in 10/25 (40%), and resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA) in 3/25 (12%). Computed tomography was incorporated into 20/25 algorithms (80%), whereas pelvic radiography was included in 18/25 (72%). Fracture morphology was used as a treatment decision point in 4/25 algorithms (16%), and pelvic packing was described in 20/25 publications (80%).
CONCLUSION: Published algorithms for the acute management of pelvic ring injuries demonstrate substantial consistency despite institutional variation. Early mechanical stabilization, physiologic assessment, damage control resuscitation, radiologic evaluation, and structured hemorrhage-control pathways were identified as the most common components of contemporary management algorithms.
